description: This Scala source file defines the hierarchy and classes related to run termination reasons within Spark's SQL pipelines, including success, failure, and specific failure types, along with associated messages and states.

classes.name: RunTerminationReason
classes.description: Sealed trait representing various reasons for run termination, including success and failure states.

classes.name: RunTerminationException
classes.description: Exception class that encapsulates a run termination reason.

classes.name: RunFailure
classes.description: Abstract sealed class for run failure reasons, including whether the failure is fatal.

classes.name: QueryExecutionFailure
classes.description: Indicates a run failure due to query execution issues, with details about flow name and retries.

classes.name: FailureStoppingOperation
classes.description: Abstract class for failures related to stopping operations, with an operation name.

classes.name: FailureStoppingFlow
classes.description: Represents failure to stop specific flows, with flow identifiers.

classes.name: UnexpectedRunFailure
classes.description: Indicates an unexpected failure with no specific root cause.

methods.name: terminalState
methods.description: Returns the terminal state of the run.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Provides a user-visible message about the run termination.

methods.name: cause
methods.description: Returns an optional Throwable cause associated with the termination reason.
